title: Dyadic Circadian and Phase-Resonant Episodic Memory Benchmark (3-Arm Ablation)
hypothesis: Indexing episodic memories with a trimmed Caelus physical phase vector (solar altitude/trend, diurnal sect, photoperiod-warped planetary-hour arc, lunar elongation, solar seasonal longitude via sceneGeometry and pheno) paired with phase-stratified compaction (retaining diurnal, photoperiod, and counterfactual travel-relocation strata) significantly improves Top-1 and Top-3 recall over Semantic-LRU and Semantic-Fixed24h on high-latitude seasonal photoperiod shifts, post-compaction nocturnal queries, and NYC-to-Tokyo travel handoffs.
null_baseline: Arm1-Semantic-LRU (semantic cosine + exponential recency decay, LRU eviction) and Arm2-Semantic-Fixed24h (semantic cosine + fixed 24h sin/cos local clock, LRU eviction; plus oracle-TZ diagnostic Arm2b-LocalCivil24h).
success_bar: Under 4x compaction (90/360 budget), Arm3-Semantic-Caelus-Photoperiod beats both Arm1 and Arm2 by >=20 percentage points Top-1 overall, >=25 pp Top-1 on high-latitude photoperiod shift queries, >=35 pp Top-1 on post-compaction nocturnal queries, and >=25 pp Top-1 on travel-handoff queries, while maintaining sub-1500 us indexing and sub-500 us query latency.
kill_criterion: If Arm3 fails to beat Arm2-Semantic-Fixed24h by >=15 pp Top-1 on high-latitude photoperiod shifts or >=20 pp Top-1 on post-compaction nocturnal recall, or degrades stationary recent control recall by >20 pp.
